title: 5.5 Exponential and Logarithmic Models

icans: I can use an exponential growth or decay model to answer questions.
I can find an exponential model from two data points.

vocab: the time it takes for half of a ___________ to decay

blocks.p: Start with 40 pennies. Each round, remove the heads and record what is left.

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Growth and decay: y = aeᵇˣ grows when b _______________ 0 and decays when b < 0.

blocks.stem: A town’s population is P = 2.5e^(0.012t) million, where t = 0 is 2010. In what year will it reach 3 million?

notes: Finding a model: use the starting value for a, then substitute a second point and solve for b with _______________.

blocks.stem: Find an exponential growth model y = aeᵇᵗ through (0, 100) and (5, 300).
Carbon-14 has a half-life of 5730 years. How much of a 10-gram sample remains after 2000 years? Round to the nearest thousandth.
A 50-gram sample decays to 40 grams in 3 days. Find its half-life.
A bacteria count is y = 500e^(0.2t) after t hours. When will there be 2000 bacteria?
A medicine has a half-life of 10 days. How much of an 80-mg dose remains after 25 days? Round to the nearest hundredth.

tickets.stem: A substance has a half-life of 4 years. What fraction remains after 12 years?
